user.title: Connect to Cuest
user.description: Enter where your Cuest server runs and its secret.

data_description.secret: Find it with: docker compose exec cuest cat /data/bridge-secret

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Cuest server. Check the address and that the server is running.
error.invalid_auth: The secret was not accepted. Copy it again from the Cuest server.
error.invalid_url: That address doesn't look right. Example: http://192.168.1.20:8787

abort.already_configured: This Cuest server is already set up.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Cuest is already set up. Only one Cuest server can be connected.

bad_secret.title: The Cuest secret does not match
bad_secret.description: The Cuest server rejected the shared secret. Remove the Cuest integration and add it again with the secret that is set on the Cuest server.

init.title: Cuest settings
init.description: What would you like to set up?

people.title: Who plays?
people.description: Pick the people who take part in quests.

people_phone.title: Phone for {person}
people_phone.description: Choose the phone that should get quest notifications for {person}, or pick No phone.

devices.title: Devices found in your home
devices.description: Cuest found these devices. Pick the ones that should create quests.

no_devices.title: No new devices found
no_devices.description: No new devices found. Cuest keeps looking, so check back later.

treats.title: House treats
treats.description: Pick the scenes, scripts or switches Cuest may switch on as treats. Tip: for 'gaming PC for 1 hour', make a script in Home Assistant that turns it on and off again after an hour.

treats_item.title: Treat: {entity}
treats_item.description: Give this treat a name and a price in gold.

celebrations.title: Celebrations
celebrations.description: Pick the lights that flash when a quest is done (longer for a level up). Optionally pick a scene to switch on when a power sprint starts. Celebration sounds are played by your own automations: listen for the cuest_quest_done and cuest_level_up events.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Cuest server. Check the address and that the server is running.
error.server_rejected: The Cuest server couldn't handle this request. Please try again.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Cuest server. Check the address and that the server is running.
abort.server_rejected: The Cuest server couldn't handle this request. Please try again.
abort.no_people: No people found. Add people in Settings → People first.

quest_not_found.message: No matching quest was found. It may already be done.

no_player.message: That person isn't linked to Cuest yet. Link them in the Cuest integration options → People.

not_connected.message: Cuest is not connected right now. Please try again in a moment.

action_failed.message: The Cuest server could not do that. Please try again.

template_title.name: Quest title
template_title.description: Complete the newest quest with this title.
